name: Steal An Evil Egg 😈
desc:
😈 Welcome to Steal An Evil Egg!

How to Play:
🥚 Steal eggs from monsters
🐣 Hatch eggs to collect rare creatures
💰 Earn money from your creatures
⬆️ Upgrade your treadmill and base
🏃 Train on the treadmill to gain Speed
🥷 Steal creatures eggs from other players
✨ Discover rarer eggs, creatures, sizes, and mutations!

🎮 Supports all platforms!
